answer: Admission auction guards the inlet: each epoch opens 200 slots; each applicant files one sealed bid, and each winner gets a marble token tied to one identity. Winners pay the clearing price, 400 credits, burned not refunded. The published delta between bids and slots exposes hidden demand. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 credits, far above one epoch's reward. An honest agent pays 400 once and earns undiluted rewards.
